review:
A 40-line pirate game on 5x4 with two features. Eight money bags start the Respin Round, where bags carry treasure values, jackpots and multipliers, and the round can retrigger.

In free spins, the pirate crew turn wild, which can create big stacked wins across the 40 lines. One of Pragmatic's older games but still widely played. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
